source_name: Ogólnopolska Baza Księgarń (OBK) official homepage/statistics teaser
observed_fact: Homepage/statistics teaser states that at end-March OBK had 1,592 registered locations, including 921 independent bookstores; same page shows a live/stat counter of 1,584 księgarnie and 83 klubokawiarnie.
use_in_probe: Count governance and QA discrepancy: treat 1,592 as dated end-March report and 1,584 as current/live homepage counter pending full crawl reconciliation.
source_quality: official OBK / Polish Book Chamber-linked surface

observed_fact: OBK is described as a free public database containing information on Polish stationary bookstores including address, activity profile, website link, and more; it is built from bookseller submissions and intended to cover all bookstores in Poland.
use_in_probe: Classify as registry-grade, self-registration/sector-administered national bookstore base rather than private directory.
source_quality: official Institute of Books program description

source_name: OBK search/listing page with filters and result rows
observed_fact: Search result pages expose visible filters for club-cafes, internet sales, awards, voivodeship, county, chain name, assortment offer, and bookstore type; individual rows expose name, phones, hours, obfuscated email, website, street address, postal code/city, voivodeship, map link, and awards/certificates. Page also exposes pagination and Razem count for the filtered result set.
use_in_probe: Field map and scraper design; proves static HTML row extraction is feasible, while emails are intentionally obfuscated in text.

source_name: OBK search/listing page filtered by offer parameter o=157
observed_fact: Filtered listing exposes a total count of 425 and 43 pages, with rows for antiquarian/used-book-adjacent stores and fields including phone, hours, obfuscated email, website, address, voivodeship, map link, and awards/certificates.
use_in_probe: Used/antiquarian overlay signal; do not treat o=157 as the full OBK count.

observed_fact: The Polish bookstore map says it is based on OBK data and directs data changes/additions to obk@pik.org.pl, with a link back to OBK.
use_in_probe: Confirms secondary map should be treated as an OBK-derived public display, not an independent source of truth.

observed_fact: Statistics archive records 2026-03-30 end-March count of 1,592 locations and 921 independent bookstores, plus earlier dated counts: 1,648 in 2025, 1,666 in August 2024, 1,690 in March 2024, and 1,729 in Q1 2023.
use_in_probe: Preserve time series and avoid mixing dated count reports with current scrape count.
